full_prompt_en: A square animated illustration looks sharply downward at a small dark-haired child crouched high above a densely packed city. The child occupies the center and foreground, close enough for large teal-blue goggles, tousled black hair, and a serious focused face to read clearly. A loose red shirt with a small round chest patch, wide rolled blue trousers, red socks, and yellow-toed red shoes create a vivid set of color blocks. One hand braces against a narrow edge at the left; the knees bend tightly toward the chest, and one shoe thrusts toward the viewer near the lower center. A small yellow pack or draped object sits behind the shoulders. Far below and around the child, streets, rooftops, balconies, signs, tiny vehicles, and clusters of people run in steep perspective. The city appears built from layered fragments: rust-red roofs, turquoise windows, faded ochre walls, narrow roads, electrical clutter, and miniature human marks. Buildings lean diagonally toward the corners, making the center feel vertiginous. The viewer seems to hover just above the crouching figure, who is looking up toward the camera despite the vast drop underneath. The image uses painterly brush grain and countless fine construction marks. Warm orange and ochre details punctuate an overall teal, blue, and gray city palette. A thin pale border contains the scene. The focal child is drawn with clean expressive anime proportions, while the surrounding environment is far more intricate and textural. Light is diffuse and slightly hazy, giving the city depth without obscuring its busy surfaces. Some signlike shapes appear but no words are reliably readable. The pose is poised and motionless, yet the extreme perspective and compressed architecture create a strong sense of speed and risk.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画插画以陡峭俯角望向一名蹲在极度密集城市高处的黑发孩子。孩子占据中央前景，靠得足够近，青蓝护目镜、蓬乱黑发和严肃专注的脸都清楚可辨。宽松红衬衣胸前有小圆徽，阔腿卷边蓝裤、红袜和黄头红鞋组成鲜明色块。一只手撑住左侧窄边，双膝紧紧收向胸前，一只鞋在下中央朝观者伸来。肩后有一个小黄背包或垂挂物。极远下方及孩子周围，街道、屋顶、阳台、招牌、小车和人群沿陡透视展开。城市像由叠层碎片建成：锈红屋顶、青绿窗、褪色赭墙、窄路、电线杂物和极小人形记号。建筑向画角斜倾，使中央令人眩晕。观者仿佛悬在蹲姿人物稍上方，而他虽脚下有巨大落差仍抬眼望向镜头。画面有绘画笔触颗粒和无数精细建筑记号。暖橙与赭色细节打断整体青蓝、蓝与灰的城市色盘。细浅边框收住画面。焦点孩子以干净有表情的动漫比例描绘，周围环境则更繁复、有肌理。光漫射而略有雾，让城市有深度又不遮去忙碌表面。一些形状像招牌，却没有可靠可读词语。姿势蓄势而静止，极端透视与压缩建筑仍制造强烈速度和风险感。
style_prompt_en: A densely detailed animated-city treatment contrasts a clear central silhouette with a dizzying field of miniature marks. Extreme downward perspective tilts structures diagonally toward the margins, and one near element projects toward the viewer. Teal, dusty blue, gray, rust red, ochre, and small bright yellow accents mingle through visibly brushed, grainy surfaces. The focal form is simplified with clean contours and broad color areas; the surrounding environment is assembled from tiny roofs, rails, wires, blocks, and streetlike fragments. A thin light border gives the busy composition a contained print quality. Diffuse haze separates depth layers while preserving a lively accumulation of detail. The style feels youthful and kinetic despite a held pose, relying on scale compression, overlapping architecture, and irregular paint texture for energy.
style_prompt_zh: 密集细致的动画城市处理让清楚中央剪影与令人眩晕的微小记号区域对照。极端俯视透视使结构斜向画边，一处近物朝观者突出。青绿、灰蓝、灰、锈红、赭与少量亮黄重音混在可见笔痕和颗粒表面中。焦点形体由清洁轮廓与宽阔色区简化；周围环境由小屋顶、栏杆、电线、方块和街路般碎片装配。细浅边框让忙碌构图带有受控印刷感。漫射薄雾分开深度层，仍保留活跃的细节积聚。风格年轻而动感，即使姿势停住，能量仍来自尺度压缩、建筑重叠与不规则颜料肌理。
theme_en: A goggle-wearing child crouches above a dizzying, intricately packed city
theme_zh: 戴护目镜的孩子蜷身蹲在精密拥挤、令人眩晕的城市上方
name: Tekkonkinkreet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
